# Bantu Pools — full reference

Bantu Pools is a swimming pool services company in Johannesburg, South Africa. Last updated 2026-09-20. Canonical site: https://www.bantupools.co.za/

## Who we are

Professional pool cleaning, equipment repairs and renovations for homes in Johannesburg and surrounds. 15+ years of experience, 500+ pools serviced, licensed and insured.

## Contact and hours

- WhatsApp / phone: +27 83 688 3238 (https://wa.me/27836883238)
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 07:00 to 17:00. 24/7 emergency call-outs.
- Quotes are free with no call-out fee. WhatsApp a photo of the pool and you will usually have a price the same day.

## Where we work

Johannesburg, Sandton, Randburg, Fourways, Midrand, Roodepoort, Bryanston, Soweto and the greater Johannesburg area. Message with your suburb to confirm availability.

## Services

### Pool cleaning and weekly maintenance
Weekly visits covering skimming, vacuuming, basket emptying, waterline tile brushing and precise chlorine and pH balancing. Includes green-to-clean rescues for neglected pools, which are usually sparkling again within a few days of treatment.

### Equipment repairs
Pump diagnostics, filter cleaning and sand replacement, gas and electric heater repair, and pressure testing to find hidden leaks. If a part cannot be saved, a replacement is quoted before any work is done.

### Renovations and resurfacing
Replastering (quartz, pebble and marble plaster), modern glass and ceramic tiling, LED lighting and coping repair.

## Frequently asked questions

### How much does pool cleaning cost in Johannesburg?
It depends on the pool's size and condition, so each pool is quoted individually, and quotes are always free. WhatsApp a photo of the pool to +27 83 688 3238 and you will usually have a price the same day, with no call-out fee.

### Can you fix a green pool?
Yes. Green-to-clean rescues are one of our specialities. Depending on how far gone the water is, most pools are sparkling again within a few days of treatment, not weeks.

### Which areas do you service?
We are based in Johannesburg and service Sandton, Randburg, Fourways, Midrand, Roodepoort, Bryanston, Soweto and the greater Johannesburg area. Message us your location and we will confirm availability.

### How often should a pool be serviced?
A weekly visit in swimming season and at least every second week in winter. Regular servicing keeps the chemistry balanced, prevents algae, and catches small equipment problems before they become expensive ones.

### Do you repair pool pumps, filters and heaters?
Yes. We diagnose and repair pumps, filters, gas and electric heaters, and pressure test to find hidden leaks. If a part is beyond saving, we quote a replacement before doing any work.

### Do I need to be home during the service?
No. As long as our team can access the pool area you do not need to be home. Many weekly clients arrange gate access and come home to a clean pool.
